paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different schema linking modules—DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot)—on the BIRD-dev dataset, measured by Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The horizontal axis represents the evaluation metrics, labeled “Recall,” “Precision,” and “F1 Score,” and arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. Each metric has three bars representing the performance of each schema linking module: DIN-SQL (zero-shot) is light blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) is dark blue, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) is light green. For Recall, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches approximately 63.58, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches approximately 71.90, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar reaches approximately 72.29. For Precision, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches approximately 88.89, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches approximately 91.24, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar reaches approximately 92.31.  For F1 Score, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches approximately 75.34, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar reaches approximately 80.40, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar reaches approximately 81.08. The bars are grouped by evaluation metric, with each module represented side-by-side within each group. No bars are visually emphasized.
